sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Source distinguishes crew lead Luis from foreman. Review chef d’équipe and contremaître roles by locale and employer, and preserve who asks, who answers and who leads the tear-off crew.

Source staging area/stage materials is temporary placement for work; archived stockage/entreposer may imply storage. Choose a consistent regional trade expression without inventing a permanent storage instruction.
Source tear-off/desmontaje identifies roof removal. Decide whether archived dépose de l’ancienne couverture narrows the operation to the covering and whether this fits the source job assignment.
Source assignment/tarea and each person has a task in a work zone. Archived tâche attribuée adds explicit assignment; align the card and Reader without changing the crew brief’s obligation.
Keep hazard reporting as a direct worker instruction; decide register and whether archived signaler/aviser preserves tell me if you see any hazard.

Source speaking task requires work zones and material staging in a two-minute morning brief. Archived speaking asks lead, staging and hazard but omits an explicit work-zone assignment; author the task only after role and staging wording are settled.
